global_style: Brutalist, high-contrast presentation style featuring hyper-saturated primary colors, rigid color blocking, overlapping typography, and black-and-white photography.

identity_anchors: Hyper-saturated primary and secondary color backgrounds
Overlapping identical text strings in contrasting colors
Repeating typographic strings used as borders and framing devices
Strictly black-and-white photography within rigid rectangular containers

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
